answers.source: utk_curio/frontend/urban-workflows/src/tests/utils/imageColumns.test.ts: 'draws a collection row once, from its thumbnail' (thumbnail stands in for image_url when both hold images), with image among the recognized columns (utk_curio/frontend/urban-workflows/src/contracts/visDefaults.json imageColumns); skills/nodes/evals/files/photo-cards.json node lincoln-photos, its content, its image_url renamed image
answers.reply:
A Simple View leaves image_url out when thumbnail holds images too: the thumbnail is the small view of the same file, so it draws each photo once, from its thumbnail, and choosing the Image column in the view does not change that.

So I changed the Lincoln Park photos node, not the view: it now returns the full photo as image instead of image_url, so both columns show side by side, the thumbnail and the full photo.

content.before:
# One row per photo of the collection, with the links a Simple View shows.
return curio_load_collection("data.curio.mapillary-sample")
content.after:
# One row per photo of the collection, with the links a Simple View shows: the
# full photo as image, beside its thumbnail.
photos = curio_load_collection("data.curio.mapillary-sample")
return photos.rename(columns={"image_url": "image"})

answers.source: utk_curio/frontend/urban-workflows/src/tests/utils/imageColumns.test.ts: 'takes a data: URI straight to the DOM', 'routes a same-origin /api path through an authenticated fetch', 'sniffs an unrecognised column only when it carries real image URLs' and 'does not sniff an extensionless URL column'; skills/nodes/evals/files/photo-cards.json node survey-photos returns local paths such as photos/2019/0001.jpg in its photo column
answers.reply:
The photo column holds local file paths, such as photos/2019/0001.jpg, and a Simple View does not count them as images, so it shows a table. In a column with another name than the image names, an image is a data:image/ URI, an /api/ path, or an http(s) URL that ends in an image extension, such as .jpg.

The fix is in the Survey photos node (survey-photos): have it return such values, for example the photos as data: URIs, or their Base64 in an image_content column. Nothing changes in the Simple View.
